# SkipKey

> SkipKey is a custom iOS keyboard that transcribes your voice entirely on-device. No cloud, no account, no data leaves your phone.

## What it does

SkipKey is an iPhone keyboard extension that lets you dictate text into any app — Messages, Notes, Mail, or any text field — using local speech recognition. You tap Start Recording in the keyboard, speak, tap Stop, and the transcript inserts automatically.

All speech recognition runs on-device using a bundled AI model. Nothing is sent to a server.

## Key features

- Local & private: voice never leaves the device
- Works in any app via the iOS custom keyboard system
- Auto-inserts the transcript when you stop recording
- Supports 25 languages with automatic detection (no selector needed)
- Optional AI post-processing: custom modes transform transcripts before insertion (e.g. translate to German, convert to semi-formal tone)
- iOS Shortcuts integration: trigger recording from the Shortcuts app
